title: Bend-cap exit ships a polyline that may still cross/sprite-clip — the spec's 'still crosses after the bend cap → STRAIGHT' half is unimplemented
detail: When the loop exits because bends == WIRE_DETOUR_MAX_BENDS, no final scan_obstacles runs: a path still violating after the 3rd bend ships bent. The shipped spec (spec-7-5, line 29) mandates 'still crosses after the bend cap → STRAIGHT'; only the length-ratio half exists.
recommended_fix: After the bend loop, run one final scan_obstacles; if found, wire_path_straight(&p, apex_a, apex_b) before the ratio check.

title: test_ribbon_fan_apex looks up nonexistent node id 8 and drops the error — passes only because the (0,false) fallback slot 0 coincides with the intended router
evidence:
rim := puck_rim_world(&v, 4)
		rs, _ := pp.node_slot(&s.topology, 8)
		nw := node_world(&s.topology, rs, 26.0)
detail: wire_setup spawns exactly 6 nodes (ids 0-5; next_node_id climbs from 0), so node_slot(8) returns (0,false); rs=0 happens to be the router at (10,10). The pin measures apex clearance from the right center by accident; a topology reorder breaks it silently. rim also uses pc=4 though the router has 8 ports.
recommended_fix: Use the real router id (0) and assert ok: rs, ok := pp.node_slot(&s.topology, 0); testing.expect(t, ok); rim := puck_rim_world(&v, 8).
